user.title: RouterOS (MikroTik)
user.description: Connect to the RouterOS REST API (RouterOS 7.1+, service `www` or `www-ssl`). The user needs the `read` and `rest-api` policies, plus `write` for the block switches (a read-only user is enough for a switch you only monitor).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate RouterOS
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {host} are no longer accepted.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid username/password, or the user lacks the rest-api policy
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the router REST API

init.title: RouterOS options
init.description: Every firewall filter rule whose comment starts with the block prefix becomes a switch: on = rule enabled = device blocked.

data.kill_connections: Drop the device's open connections when blocking
data.monitor_ports: Monitor ethernet ports (link, link speed, RX/TX rate)
